## Requirements: Unified Overlay & Operation Surface Design System (Web / App)

### Problem / reviewed baseline (2026-11-10)
Nession has reusable popups but lacks one **cross-family overlay presentation / behavior contract**. Source review of `main` + `staging` confirms:
- `web/src/components/ui/dialog.tsx` (Base UI) and `alert-dialog.tsx` (Radix) diverge: scrim `bg-overlay/10` vs `bg-overlay/80`, dialog `rounded-xl / p-4 / text-base` vs alert `sm:rounded-lg / p-6 / text-lg`, different motion, max-width/viewport handling. This is a shared primitive boundary, not a Project-only form bug.
- `staging` Dialog supports `centered | sheet | fullscreen` (#3089) and `DialogFooter sticky` (#3128), but Attach/Create Session/Project still pick their own `sm:max-w-[40rem|45rem]` and sticky header styling. A generic size/anatomy/scroll contract is missing.
- `DropdownMenu` and `Popover` use `usePopupPortalContainer` to preserve Experience scope, while examined `Select`, `ContextMenu`, `Tooltip`, `Dialog` use default Portal paths. Do **not** assume a runtime failure from source inspection alone; verify in actual App/forced-Experience browser cases.
- `ContextMenuItem` has no demonstrated App hit-target band counterpart to `DropdownMenuItem`; verify measured dimensions and interaction. Z-index, scroll ownership, nesting and focus/dismissal rules are not globally specified.
- Existing `docs/design/design-system/components.md` lists Dialog/Sheet/Popover but does not define a coherent overlay hierarchy/size/scroll recipe across Web/App.

### Boundary and dedupe
This is a **new shared overlay-system invariant**, not a reopened #3089 (Attach/Create Session/Project responsive flows) or #3128 (sticky footer bleed), both closed with their historical receipts. Coordinate the open **#3137** (resource-detail/configuration/operation visual grammar): #3137 owns **content hierarchy and product recipes**; this issue owns **overlay primitives, surface/depth choice, presentation/stacking/dismissal**. Reuse their existing business flows; no transport/session/project behavior redesign or wholesale design DSL.

### Proposed unified model (product decision to validate with the prototype)
1. **Semantic surface taxonomy**: Tooltip (informational), Context Menu/Select (anchored choices), Popover (brief contextual controls), Confirm/Alert (critical interruption), Simple Dialog (short action), Complex Operation (multi-step edit). State when *not* to use a modal; anchored popups must not become full operation editors.
2. **Web**: centered compact / standard / wide layout **roles**, initially ~400–480 / ~640 / ~720–800 CSS px, **not fixed literals**; clamp to usable viewport margins, respect long paths/URLs, focus, reduced motion and height constraints. Height belongs to content until constrained, then Header / sole scrollable Body / persistent opaque Footer; avoid nested competing form scrollers. For simple popovers/menus, anchor with collision/available-height behavior and complete text access.
3. **App**: same semantic intent but **Experience-selected** presentation; short one-action intent may use a bottom sheet, substantial form/edit is a pushed/full-height operation page, destructive confirmation has a small accessible mobile confirmation surface. Exactly one App Back/header owner per depth, preserve draft and current Session/Terminal until explicit commit. Do not branch solely on CSS viewport: forced `?experience=web|app` must retain its experience behavior.
4. **Cross-family visual grammar**: consistent token-owned surface/elevation/scrim/radius/typography/gap/motion/action bands; Warning/destructive conveys meaning without inventing unrelated styling. AlertDialog and Dialog may retain different primitives for semantics but must share a visual owner. Avoid wholesale replacement of Radix/Base UI solely for branding.
5. **Portal / stacking / dismissal ownership**: overlay stack with explicit precedence for dialog, nested select/menu, contextual popover, tooltip; preserve Experience CSS scope, focus trap vs nonmodal focus, Escape/back/outside-click, keyboard navigation/restore focus, no action on cancel, accessible labelling. Nession host decides layering; extensions may contribute content but cannot define competing global chrome.
6. **Usage contract**: shared generic primitives in `web/src/components/ui`; product pattern/composition determines which overlay is appropriate; cross-Experience adaptation owned by shell; domain input/actions remain capability-local. No new universal form DSL or feature-specific magic dimensions.
7. **Migration inventory**: audit at least Session Attach/Create; Project Create/Rename/Delete/Settings; Agent actions; Files create/rename/delete/unsaved; Env selection/edit; Sandbox policy operation; Settings; Workspace contextual menus/Select; any native `alert/confirm` remnants. Record `current behavior → target surface role → existing owner → proposed migration/proof`. Prioritize confirmed regressions and reusable owners, not arbitrary bulk restyling.

### Verification scenarios / exact observable proof
- **SC-01 → SCN-01**: PR-head canonical design docs + named owners and deterministic design Gate/pattern contract; prove taxonomy, non-goals and no parallel owner.
- **SC-02–04 → SCN-02**: source-aligned Chromium + Playwright browser Cases at canonical `design/contracts/viewports.json` (Web 1440/1180/1024, App 375/390/430 + 844×390; forced Experience). Assert real DOM computed geometry/scrollWidth/overlay stacking/keyboard-focus/touch hit area and state transitions, with one negative case for cancel/back/invalid; no prototype substitutes for product proof.
- **SC-05 → SCN-08**: exact orphan `prototype` commit, README/gallery/source pin + verified Pages manifest/HTML readback and a browser mock walkthrough. Proven mock publication never proves real React component behavior.

### Success Criteria
- [x] SC-01 A canonical Overlay & Operation Surface pattern specifies the six surface roles, Web/App usage decision tree, anatomy, semantic size roles, palette/elevation/scrim, keyboard/focus/dismissal/stack/portal/scroll ownership and negative examples, with one durable owner in the existing Design System and an explicit relation to #3137.
- [ ] SC-02 Production Web representative Attach/Create Session/Project/Delete and one anchored Menu/Select/Popover flow each render according to the shared role/size/anatomy at 1440/1180/1024 and constrained-height fixtures: no unintended horizontal scroll, no clipped full values without inspect/copy, Header remains legible and Footer opaque/flush with one intended content scroll owner.
- [ ] SC-03 Production App 375/390/430 portrait and 844×390 landscape representative sheet / full-height operation / confirmation / anchored choice surfaces preserve the single Back/header owner, App control hit-targets, safe-area and keyboard geometry and user draft/session context on back/cancel; forced App vs forced Web follows Experience, not only viewport.
- [ ] SC-04 In production browser scenarios, Dialog/AlertDialog and nested popup families use the approved common visual/portal/stack contract: child choices are operable above their parent without false dismissals, Escape/outside/cancel behavior is intentional, focus is restored, alert confirmation never silently performs a destructive action, and at least one invalid and one unavailable state remain readable/operable.
- [ ] SC-05 A source-aligned interactive `overlay-system-3142` prototype/gallery supports switching Web↔App, compact/standard/wide operations, Alert/Confirm, anchored menus/Select/Popover, long path, overflow, keyboard, disabled/offline and cancel/confirm flows. Its immutable source pin and independently checked published HTML/manifest are recorded with mock-vs-production fidelity limits.

## Prototype

- **Decision:** Required — interaction/structure across multiple overlay families and Web/App compositions.
- **Candidate:** separate `overlay-system-3142` interactive pattern gallery; one host review frame, realistic Session/Project/Files operations and controllable fixtures outside product viewport.
- **Uncertainty:** when to use sheet vs operation page on App; Compact/Standard/Wide Web roles; common Dialog/Alert visual grammar; nested popover/Select and focus + scroll layers.
- **Source (verified at immutable commit):** https://github.com/BestNathan/nession/tree/82945fb47342a98b8ac5ab2110247079060a285b/overlay-system-3142 . The root prototype catalog and gallery also reference this directory at the same branch commit.
- **Direct rendered HTML candidate (publication not yet verified):** https://bestnathan.github.io/nession/prototypes/overlay-system-3142/index.html . Do **not** label it live until the trusted Pages manifest and HTTPS readback match the source.
- **Fidelity / walkthrough:** Web 1440/1180/1024, App 390/375/430/landscape, Normal/long/Offline/Invalid fixtures, compact/standard/wide, nested select/env/menu/popover, App attach sheet/settings, explicit confirm/cancel. Mock only; no real Session/Project changes.
- **Source checks (2026-11-10):** all four prototype files plus gallery `index.html` and catalog `README.md` fetched at 82945fb47342a98b8ac5ab2110247079060a285b; HTML publisher anchors present; JavaScript parsed successfully. **Not yet browser tested** (no measured DOM / Chromium proof) and **not verified published** (Pages HTTPS / manifest not accessible during this review). Production SC/E2E all Pending.
- **Reference:** #3089 clickable Session operation prototype (historical scenario reference); do not repin/change its already accepted deliverable when not changing the domain flow.

## Product alignment

- [x] VISION.md: one coherent workspace experience across devices and tools.
- [x] PRINCIPLE.md: work-first, progressive disclosure, precision, Nession-owned extension UX.
- [x] Reviewed relevant `docs/design/{visual-language,interaction,design-system}` and `web/AGENTS.md`; this requirement introduces **no new design-system layer**.
- [x] No Session/Project protocols, persistent Session state or agent transport redesign; no replacing real acceptance with prototype screenshots.

### Knowledge Impact
- Decision: Create
- Related knowledge: `docs/design/design-system/components.md`, `patterns.md`, a focused overlay surface pattern spec, `docs/design/interaction/{web,app}.md`, `design/contracts/`.
- Reason: New durable product-wide overlay choice/geometry/interaction contract, beyond any individual dialog implementation.
- Owner and timing: Design-system owner defines canonical pattern and contracts before Web/App migrations; browser tests updated with implementation PR.
- Evidence: This issue, source review of `main`/`staging`, future exact-SHA browser and published prototype receipts.

**Related:** #3137, #3089, #3128, #3136, #774, #2750.
